title: AccountSet
key_points: The AccountSet transaction sets the account's properties.
It can set various properties such as classic staple, inflation rate, and escape hatch.
The transaction uses flags to specify which properties are being modified.
limitations: Scope is limited to the functionality of the AccountSet transaction within the XRP Ledger system.
asserts: The AccountSet transaction allows an account holder to modify their account's properties, such as classic staple and inflation rate, using flags.
